propositions: A new attach-commits verb (CLI, library, MCP) must retroactively link commits to a ticket by recording COMMITS events, with all-or-nothing SHA validation before any event is recorded.
Invalid commit SHAs must be rejected with an error naming each offender, and a partial batch must record nothing, leaving state.commits unchanged.
A deterministic close-gate check must block if any linked commit's changed paths are not declared in file_impact and do not match exemption globs (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md).
Merge commits must be skipped in the close check, not read as empty path lists, to avoid false passes.

The close check must union file_impact over both source-(i) linked commits and source-(ii) referencing commits from the same ticket-and-descendant scope, and must skip unresolvable source-(i) SHAs while failing closed on unreadable source-(ii) commits.
The shared commit_impact module must not import rebar.llm, and both existing glob_match implementations (prompts, registry) must delegate to a single canonical helper.
